item.title: ConvertMyVideo - Walkthrough
item.description:
Overview

  • Platform: TryHackMe
  • Difficulty: Medium
  • OS: Linux
  • Attacker IP: 192.168.147.6
  • Target Machine IP: 10.130.173.90

The objective was to exploit a command injection vulnerability in the web application to gain initial access, then enumerate the system to identify privilege escalation paths and ultimately obtain root access.

Port Scanning

RustScan

I started with a full port scan using RustScan and Nmap’s default scripts and version detection.

rustscan -a 10.130.173.90 -b 500 -- -sC -sV -A -oN nmap/init

Results
